query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.name,'source',r.data->'source') AS "complement!" FROM knowledge_relations r JOIN products p ON p.tenant=r.tenant AND p.id=CASE WHEN r.source_id=$2 THEN r.target_id ELSE r.source_id END WHERE r.tenant=$1 AND r.kind='PAIRS_WITH' AND (r.source_id=$2 OR r.target_id=$2) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 50
